coverage_questions: The paper does not specify the exact DNA tokenizer vocabulary, special-token IDs, truncation side, or attention-mask construction for Evo2-1B and NT-500M.
The paper states that projected DNA sequences and query/special-token embeddings are stacked, but does not specify their exact order or separator placement.
The detailed multimodal input construction for the Enformer-Qwen3 experiment is not reported; only integration of Enformer embeddings with Qwen3 backbones is stated.
The exact BIOREASON configurations selected for GRPO are not enumerated in prose; the paper states only that selected DNA-LLM models received GRPO fine-tuning.
The LLM-only baseline does not document its raw-text serialization, tokenizer/template details, sequence order, truncation behavior, or attention mask.
The paper does not specify the computation performed by the DNA-only classifier after the attention-head representation.
The paper does not establish the exact input serialization or text prompt structure used for the Enformer chromatin-accessibility experiment.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The paper states that Qwen3 baselines receive text queries and DNA sequences treated as plain text strings, but does not establish whether the assembly is serialization, concatenation, tokenization, or a specific chat-template sequence.

The paper states that DNA-only models use a trained classifier after the attention-head representation, but does not specify whether that classifier is linear, multilayer, lookup-based, normalized, or another computation.

evidence.quote: To demonstrate that BIOREASON's architecture generalizes beyond unsupervised DNA foundation models, we conducted an additional experiment integrating a supervised DNA model, Enformer [3], for chromatin accessibility prediction.
Enformer-Qwen3-1.7B and Enformer-Qwen3-4B (DNA-LLM): BIOREASON hybrids integrating Enformer embeddings with Qwen3 backbones.
The human genome was segmented into 200bp bins, with each bin representing a classification instance.
